verdict.rationale: Baseten has a documented Model APIs deprecation page that offers a migration path (moving to a dedicated deployment with the deprecated model weights, with support on request). It also mentions stable development, staging and production environments for deployments. However, the evidence covers model deprecation rather than versioning of the API surface itself, with no stated notice periods or timelines. missing for 10: explicit API versioning scheme, documented deprecation timelines/notice periods, changelog or version-pinning guarantees, independent corroboration.
